scenes.heading: Your Computer-Based *Examination*
scenes.body: Everything you need to know before, during and after
narration: Hello, and welcome. If you are sitting the computer-based examination, this short video is for you.
We will walk through what to do before, during and after your exam.

scenes.heading: Exam day should hold *no surprises*
narration: Most problems on exam day come from small things that were never explained.
So you will learn what to bring and how to sign in.
And you will see exactly how the timer behaves.

scenes.heading: What to *bring*
scenes.note: Arrive early, so you are settled before the countdown begins
narration: Bring your username and password, exactly as issued to you.
Bring a valid means of identification.
Bring your device, fully charged, with a charger or power bank.
You will also need internet data, and pens with plain paper for the theory section.
And a tip: arrive early, so you are settled before the countdown begins.

scenes.heading: Open the *exam portal*
scenes.body: Use the browser on your own device.

mockup.title: Welcome
mockup.subtitle: Enter the details issued to you

narration: Step one. Open the browser on your device and go to the exam portal.
Type your username and password, then sign in.

scenes.heading: Five steps to *start*

items.title: Username
items.text: Type it exactly as it was issued to you.

items.title: Password
items.text: Passwords are case sensitive, so check your caps lock.

items.title: Instructions
items.text: Read every instruction before you continue.

items.title: Confirm details
items.text: If anything is wrong, correct it right there.

items.title: Start exam
items.text: When the countdown reaches zero, tap Start.

narration: First, enter your username.
Next, type your password.
Then read the instructions carefully.
Confirm that your details are correct.
Finally, when the countdown reaches zero, start your examination.

scenes.heading: The numbers to *remember*

items.title: minutes left when the timer turns red

narration: Your paper has fifty questions.
You have forty-five minutes to answer them.
When five minutes remain, the timer turns red.

scenes.heading: Small choices, *big difference*

rightPoints: Charge fully, bring a power bank

narration: Avoid arriving late, a low battery, or closing your browser tab.
Instead, arrive early, charge fully, and stay on the exam page until you submit.

scenes.heading: Prepared candidates are *confident* candidates.
scenes.body: You now know what to expect.
narration: Prepared candidates are confident candidates, and you now know what to expect.

scenes.heading: Northfield *Institute*
scenes.body: We wish you every success in your examination.
narration: From all of us, good luck. We wish you every success.
